description_en: Modifies the permissions of an account for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）账号的权限
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore grant-account-privilege --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --account-name demoaccount --account-privilege RoleReadWrite --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantAccountPrivilege

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the account belongs
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the account. You can call the [DescribeAccounts](~~DescribeAccounts~~) operation to obtain the name of the account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The permissions of the account. Default value: RoleReadWrite. Valid values:

RoleReadOnly: The account has the read-only permissions.
RoleReadWrite: The account has the read and write permissions
parameters.help_zh:
账号权限，取值：
RoleReadOnly：只读权限。
RoleReadWrite：读写权限，默认值
parameters.name: account_privilege
